common: Use the original question, options and supplied evidence. Other agents' reasoning is fallible, not new patient data. Preserve the requested comparison, quantities, direction, negation, time and evidence status. No external retrieval, images, raw study data or new examinations are available. A predicted finding is not observed; nonsignificance does not establish equivalence. Referenced payloads are included inline in this message: resolve payload_ref using inline_payloads. Return only the requested JSON, concisely, without repeating the same explanation across fields. A valid reference or agreement is not medical proof.
brief: Before specialist work, state the actual decision and comparison criterion without selecting an answer. Assign each recruited role a relevant contribution using the available resources. Do not create extra specialty questions or change source facts. This plan does not override the original question.
work: Produce your original specialist contribution to the requested decision. Question roles interpret the case; options roles compare the offered options using the provided question work. Give up to three decision-relevant claims, including a competing explanation or essential limit where relevant. Distinguish supplied observations from calculations, background inference, prediction and unavailable information. Source IDs have explicit original text in the source packet; pointing to an ID does not prove a claim. Do not fill arrays for completeness. If you cannot contribute, say outside_role.
synthesis: Answer the original decision using the actual original work and any completed assistance products. Select only decision-critical claims and explain their actual role and interpreted use; preserve their conditions and disagreements. Unselected work remains available but is not recorded as adopted. Keep a concise coherent report. For each open issue provide your actual response, including a reason to keep, revise or remain uncertain. Report wording changes do not prove resolution; the original issue owner will reassess. Never turn an inference into a supplied finding or a suggestion into a completed examination.
clinical: Independently cross-monitor the current clinical reasoning in your original role. Check the requested decision, support, important counterevidence, quantities/direction and limits. Raise a specific problem or omission only if it matters for this decision, and explain the feasible reasoning work needed. You are not being asked whether an integrator understood your words. No faithful/accurate label is provided for this review. Do not force criticism or consensus; use no_concern or outside_role when appropriate. Reassess each of your prior clinical issues against the actual current report and receiver response; do not close it merely because text changed.
meaning: Check only how YOUR original claims or completed work products were interpreted and used by the integrator. A claim can be faithfully understood while you medically disagree. Identify the particular claim and correction when misrepresented. If your work is not currently represented, say not_represented; this does not assert the report is clinically complete. You have not been shown this round's clinical review outputs. Reassess each of your prior meaning issues using the actual receiver response and current use, separately from medical agreement.
huddle: Adjust the current reasoning plan for the actual open issues. Decide which need action, are declined with a reason, or remain pending. Where feasible, ask an existing member to perform a concrete operation with a specified work product and owner. Available operations only reconsider supplied information or existing knowledge. Do not request new examinations or external verification as if they can be performed here. No new work is required when existing reasoning is sufficient. Do not count a planned task as completed or a declined issue as resolved.
accept: You are the assigned original member receiving a concrete request for assistance. Confirm the task you accept and what you can actually do with the available information, or state why you cannot perform it. Do not invent tools or claim the work is already completed. Your acceptance will be followed by a separate work call.
assistance: Perform only the concrete reasoning work you accepted. Return a useful work product and relevant claims with their evidence status and limits. Explain implications for the original decision. If it cannot be completed with the actual resources, state unable_to_complete. No new test result or external source has been obtained. This is task assistance, not a request to agree with the coordinator or repeat your earlier answer.
final_context: Current report dependencies, completed work and remaining issues are fallible reasoning. Original question/options and supplied evidence remain authoritative. Receipt, acceptance and accurate representation are not clinical correctness; unresolved issues remain visible. Choose the best offered option without treating team agreement as evidence.
